crossConcepts.reason: Tangency/discriminant is the selected primary L3: it gives the two tangent slopes m=±√t. The separate perpendicular-lines property m₁m₂=−1 is necessary to obtain t=1. CC_DISCRIMINANT and CC_TANGENCY would duplicate primary L3.
